desc: The hot drop zone (owner, Nov 7): each match picks one named area with better loot. Picked from the map's non-perch islands by seed, never the same one twice in a row in this game. Shown on the drop map and the minimap in one colour with a label.
tier_up_doc: Rarity steps added to chest and monster loot inside the zone (on top of the region's own bonus).
label: HOT ZONE
